newsitem.title: USA: Cytel, Baxter unit in pact.
newsitem.headline: Cytel, Baxter unit in pact.

text.p: Cytel Corp and Baxter Healthcare Corp's Nextran unit said Tuesday they had agreed to collaborate on the development of a product used in xenotransplantation.
Xenotransplantation is the process of transplanting animal organs into humans.
Under the agreement, Cytel will manufacture and sell a carbohydrate that Nextran will incorporate into a xenotransplant product, the companies said.
Nextran will make an unspecified payment to Cytel and make an equity investment in Cytel in exchange for the right to enter into an exclusive supply agreement.
The deal also provides for product development milestone payments to Cytel, the companies said.
Baxter Healthcare is a unit of Baxter International Inc.

In xenotransplantation, animal organs are often rejected by the human body. Nextran said it will try to prevent this by using an alpha-galactose carbohydrate manufactured by Cytel to filter the transplant recipient's blood to remove rejection-causing antibodies.
